objective: Notes parser and deterministic grounding verifier with unit tests.
context: Built against design spec sections 5, 3.5, 11.1 and SCOPE D4. No memory records matched. eval/verifier corpus does not exist yet (QA-owned), so the tests use an inline mini corpus and read forbidden-stopwords.txt if present.
acceptanceCriteria: Parser supports the three formats, physical line numbers in errors, limits enforced (D5)
Verifier implements reason codes, normalisation, stoplist v1 and union-of-cited-lines rules; pure, idempotent, no input mutation (D4)
Stoplist written before any model output; benchmark test passes
completedWork: parseNotes (text/json, ISO and bracketed times, physical line errors capped at 20 with total, 2000-line/2000-char/64-author limits, control chars, time validation). Verifier: normalize.js, tokens.js, units.js, stopwords.js (v1), index.js exporting buildContext, verifyStatement, verifyDraft, MIN_SUPPORT. Decisions: cited text includes author, text, time and ISO ts; verifyDraft takes {sections:{name:[stmt]}} and returns {sections:{name:[{status,reasons}]}}; digits glued to units are split (5min, 40%) and digit-hyphen-unit forms are split on both sides.
remainingIssues: Real verifier corpus (eval/verifier) and tune set not yet available; M1b/M1c should be re-checked by QA against it.
nextAction: QA to run the eval/verifier corpus against src/verify; AI engineer fallback.js to consume the verifier.
